timeline.heading: Objective
timeline.description: My phone case has two parts: the rubber cushioning and the plastic holding it all together. For this project, I wanted to 3D model and print the plastic part since it is a challenging design to replicate and I could modify the design to give extra functionality to the case, like a wallet holder.

timeline.heading: Modeling
timeline.description: At first, I tried to create a flat sheet and extend the edges to model it into the shape of the cover, but I found it was really tedious. I tried looking for different approaches when I realized that I could create a box with the dimensions of the case, hollowing it, and make cuts into it until it looks like the case. I quickly abandoned my original strategy and went ahead with that plan. Throughout the process, I used fillets and chamfers to polish the look.
